environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on GKE Autopilot cluster with hardened pod security context. Container runs with securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true at pod spec level. No emptyDir, hostPath, or PVC volumes mounted. The container's ephemeral storage layer is enforced read-only by the containerd runtime via OCI spec annotation 'org.opencontainers.image.readonly=true'. Additionally, the GKE node pool uses COS_CONTAINERD image with integrity monitoring. The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only kube-dns (UDP/53) and the internal service mesh sidecar. Pod runs as non-root (runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65534). No service account token automounted. Resource limits set to 128Mi memory, 100m CPU.

config.volumes: none (no emptyDir, no PVC, no hostPath, no tmpfs)
